description: Agent Agriculture Records: submit soil test and nutrient records with the testing schedule and fertilizer applications they answer to: the moment the records are read at; each field with its id, reference, name and the days its records allow between soil tests; each soil test with its id, reference, field, the moment sampled and the moment due; each nutrient recommendation with its id, reference, the soil test behind it, field, nutrient and the rate recommended; each fertilizer application with its id, reference, field, product, nutrient, the nutrient rate applied and the moment applied. The signed report gives the fields and the soil tests, each scheduled field against a current soil test on file at the reading moment, each fertilizer application against the recommendation for its nutrient on its field, each soil test against the day it fell due, and each nutrient recommendation against an application record behind it, and counts them, and names divergent soil records: a field with no current soil test on file against the schedule the records state, a fertilizer application the soil record does not support, a soil test recorded past due, and a nutrient recommendation in the record with no application record behind it; then a recommendation naming a soil test the records do not hold and a soil test on a field the field records do not hold, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No fields, a soil test schedule with no reading moment, applications with no recommendations beside them, or recommendations with no applications beside them leaves those points unverified. Fields, tests and recommendations match by letters and digits, a recommendation reads on the field it names or its soil test’s field, nutrients match by their usual names with N read as nitrogen, P, phosphate and P2O5 as phosphorus and K, potash and K2O as potassium, an application is unsupported when no recommendation for its nutrient on its field stands behind it or its rate passes the recommended rate, and a soil test falls due on the day it states or on its field’s previous test plus the interval. This reads whether every field’s soil test is current and every fertilizer application and recommendation answer each other. Verdict agri_soil_divergent, agri_soil_partial, agri_soil_unverified or agri_soil_consistent. POST /api/agri-soil-check. Reads the farm production records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it visits no farm, takes no soil or tissue sample, contacts no regulator or certifier and issues no certification, which stay with the operation, its agronomists, its regulators and its certifiers, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Agriculture Records reads a farm operation’s own production records: crop and production plan records, planting and seed records, pesticide and fertilizer application records, irrigation and water-use records, soil test and nutrient records, harvest and yield records, livestock records and field-to-lot traceability records, each against the planting, input application and harvest records, the plan’s fields, varieties and windows and the seed records, the applicator and license records and the pre-harvest intervals, the schedule, the water allocation and the fields the plan lists, the planting and application records, the birth, purchase, movement and treatment records and the herd count, the planting and harvest records and the shipments, or the testing schedule, the fertilizer applications and the nutrient recommendations on record. The family’s ground is the paper trail behind the crop and the herd: what the plan calls for, what the field logs show, what was applied and when, and whether the harvest and the traceability hold up; the Agent Food Safety Records family reads a food business’s safety records downstream, after production, and the Agent Customs Records family reads the border filings for goods, while this family reads the farm’s own records upstream, in the field, and reads neither. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-agriculture-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-agriculture-records/.
